action.instructions: Which strategy should the ship follow for the next second to stay alive and destroy rocks and saucers?

criteria.aim: Hold the ship in place. Turn to the target a torpedo can reach soonest and fire when lined up. No thrust.
criteria.escape: Fly the thrust manoeuvre that takes the ship out of the path of the objects, and fire at whatever is lined up on the way.
criteria.brake: Thrust against the ship's drift until it is nearly still, and fire at whatever is lined up on the way.
criteria.hyperspace: Press the hyperspace key, which jumps to a random place on the screen. The jump can destroy the ship.
